title: A Multi-Perspective Machine Learning Approach to Evaluate Police-Driver Interaction in Los Angeles

bias_targets.methodology: Developing multimodal machine learning models to analyze audio, video, and transcript data from police body-worn cameras to identify racial disparities in police communication, respectfulness, and de-escalation during traffic stops.
Integrating the geographic location and socioeconomic characteristics of communities into the framework to analyze disparities in how police interact with drivers across different neighborhoods.

Using multi-perspective soft-labeling techniques to capture subjective, diverse interpretations of police-civilian interactions from various stakeholders, rather than enforcing a single 'ground truth' that may privilege powerful viewpoints.
